_note: ZOZOBRA interior design renders supplied by the restaurant. They are the ground truth for every scene: LILO is composited INTO these plates (image-to-image with her LoRA), and atmosphere B-roll is animated FROM them, so the space shown on social is the real design, never an invented restaurant. They are renders, not photos. If this space is a branch that hasn't opened yet, set stage to 'coming_soon' and the Brain will frame content as a teaser.
signature_elements: a towering tiered lantern canopy of backlit warm-paper panels crowning a circular bar, with liquor bottles on a ring shelf and wine glasses hanging upside down beneath it
sculptural crimson silk ribbons swirling across the dark ceiling
stepped black-metal slatted screen partitions with irregular vertical bars
charred-bark textured dark walls lit by warm grazing uplights
polished dark concrete floor with glowing LED strips along raised platforms
cylindrical rust-copper pendants and slim black cylinder pendants
black textured boucle armchairs with round bolster backrests and rough-hewn dark wooden tables with candles
potted bamboo, dry twisted branches in large stoneware vases
an entrance corridor under a cascading golden fringe ceiling installation
an open kitchen with white tiles glowing behind the circular bar
